title: Connectors
subtitle: As the CLI reported them {{when}}
intro: The claude.ai connectors of the signed-in account, as Claude Code lists them. Agentry only reads this list: it cannot authorise, change or call a connector itself.
cliFailed: The CLI could not list its connectors
noneHint: The CLI lists none for this account. Connect Docs, Gmail or Calendar in claude.ai's connector settings and ask again.

ask.title: Ask Claude
ask.hint: Opens a new chat with the prompt already written. The prompt only asks Claude to read, and any permission the connector's tools need is asked for in that chat.
ask.none: No prepared prompts for this connector.

unavailable.title: Out of reach
unavailable.intro: Agentry talks to Claude Code only through its CLI, so anything the CLI has no command for stays out of reach:
